author: @FaisalAsmaty
text:
**"I only discovered K-pop two years ago because I come from a country where singing isn’t seen as something ‘good’—people mock singers for their lyrics or outfits. When the Taliban took over, all the singers fled to survive, so I never had much interest in music. It wasn’t that I hated songs, but I just… didn’t connect with them. My family listened to music, but I didn’t like my country’s songs.

Then a Blink friend showed me BLACKPINK, and while I liked it, it didn’t click. She showed me BTS too, but still, my heart didn’t feel anything. Then one day, I found Chk Chk Boom—and the moment I heard it, I knew: THIS is the music I love! That’s how I became a Stay.

Now with ‘Lose My Breath’ and ‘Chk Chk Boom,’ I keep thinking… they just keep getting better and better! 😭💖 Thank you, Stray Kids, for making music that finally touched my heart. ♥"**

text:
عندما وصلنا، كانت الطبيعة الخلابة تنتظرنا. الأشجار العالية، الأنهار الصافية، والهواء النقي جعلتني أشعر بالراحة لأول مرة منذ أسابيع. "هذا المكان جميل." قلت لسوهو بينما كنا نسير في الغابة.

"أعلم أنكِ تحتاجين إلى هذا الهدوء." قال وهو يبتسم. "أردت أن أريحك من كل الضغوط."

كنت أشعر بالامتنان له. "شكرًا لك، سوهو. أنتِ دائمًا تعرف ما أحتاجه."

في تلك الليلة، بينما كنا نجلس حول النار، أخبرني سوهو عن خططه للمستقبل. "أريد أن أفتح معرضًا للوحاتي. ربما في المدينة الكبيرة."

"هذه فكرة رائعة." قلت بحماس. "لوحاتك تستحق أن يراها العالم."

نظر إليَّ بعينين مليئتين بالأمل. "هل تعتقدين أنني أستطيع فعل ذلك؟"

"بالطبع، سوهو. أنتِ موهوب جدًا." قلت بثقة.

كانت تلك الرحلة بمثابة نقطة تحول بالنسبة لي. بدأت أشعر بأنني أقوى، وأنني قادرة على مواجهة التحديات. سوهو كان دائمًا بجانبي، يدعمني ويشجعني.

عندما عدنا إلى الفيلا، كنت أشعر بأنني مستعدة لمواجهة العالم مرة أخرى. "سنكون بخير، أليس كذلك؟" سألت سوهو.

ابتسم وقال: "بالطبع، هارين. طالما أننا معًا، سنكون بخير."

**عنوان القصيدة: "غيابك لا يُعوَّض"**

أمي..  
غيابك **كسرٌ في قلبي**،  
لا يداويه زمان،

كنتِ كالشمس في حياتي،

كشتاء بلا نهاية.

في صوت الرياح،  
في ضوء القمر،  
في صمت الليل.

كأنكِ نجمة في سماء أخرى،  
أراها من بعيد،

أمي..  
تعلمين أنني أحبك،  
وأن غيابك ترك فيّ فراغًا،

لكنني سأحاول أن أكون قويًا،  
لأنني أعلم أنكِ تريدين لي الخير،  
وأنكِ ستظلين دائمًا في قلبي،

What you have been and are capable of, is absolutely untouchable and I’ve learned that there is nothing that can take the sincerity and passion out of your character. I will say, despite being a long-time fan of K-Pop, I didn’t become a Stay until 2019. I don’t know how I went so long without knowing or supporting Stray Kids sooner, but I am completely and utterly thrilled to be a Stay now. To this day I wouldn’t know about Stray Kids if it weren’t for the Stay. I heard so much conversation among the fans of Stray Kids about how fearless of a leader you were, and I became curious. Over the course of 2019-2020, I spent my free time, which I had a lot of then, getting to know you and your members. It started with liking a few songs, but then Stay, who talk with so much praise about you and your members, convinced me to see what was lying beneath the meaning of your music. I began to watch Stray Kids content whenever and of whatever I could, and I gradually fell more in love with your performance and personality overall. I have come to know how passionate and dedicated you are and have always been to music and performing. Even before Stray Kids was officially formed and debuted, you had music in your heart and I can see that clearly every time that you go on stage with your members. Not only do you have a naturally beautiful voice evident of vocal capability and strength, but your dancing skills are rigid and flawless beyond words. Your presence on stage is nothing less than inspirational and you ground and center your members in a way that I’ve never seen before. You always bring everyone together and emit unity on and off the stage. Outside of your musical performances, however, I have gotten the pleasure of getting to know you and your personality. I don’t even really know where to start by how touched I am at the positive impact you have already made on this world; even right after your debut. Before I became a Stay, I didn’t know much about what Stray Kids had gone through to get where they are now; and I didn’t know just how much you went through either. However, the loving Stay introduced me to how hard you worked individually to keep your members’ heads above water through the rigorous days of training, performing, and other events that swarmed you. I was, and still am absolutely mesmerized at what you have accomplished to make this group possible, and successful beyond its comprehension. Thanks to the Stay, I know that before Stray Kids even debuted, you formed an unbreakable and unique bond with each of the members as well as one together as a whole. You lift your members up with the emotional and motivational weight of all the words that you’ve ever said to them. To know that there would be no Stray Kids without you makes me love you in a manner that is simply indescribable. I know that I, your members, and the Stay have so much respect and admiration for you because of everything that you’ve done and overcome in just the beginning of your musical journey. I have gotten the honor of seeing at least some of the group’s history and how it came to be, and seeing how you were a huge part of that makes me appreciate having you in my life more than I did before. You have single-handedly helped carry this group to victory and done so much to ensure that you stay together. You have always kept your promise that you, in words that I once heard you say, “Don’t leave anybody behind.” On top of leading your group to all of its success and glory, your are also humble and kind and always put them first. You sacrifice so much for your music, your members, and Stay and we recognize how hard you work day in and day out. You are so funny, clever, and know not to take life too seriously. At the same time you are professional, intelligent, respectful, and wise beyond your years. You are every bit qualified to be the leader that you are and I hope you never doubt your capability of doing that because Stay have seen you build something beautiful with your own two hands from the ground up. You never gave up even when the world encouraged you to and from that I find so much inspiration that I don’t even know how how to thank you. All I do know is that your family and parents are the most proud of you and love you more than any of us do. I can’t even imagine how strong they think you are for what you’ve created. I don’t want to put any more pressure or a burden on you, but so much would crash and burn without you and I hope that our love and support is enough to lift you up through your darkest times. You deserve so many blessings and praise. I just hope that you know your efforts are being recognized every second and that Stay, your members, and your family love you beyond words. I can’t thank you enough for everything that you’ve already done. You make Stay and your members feel so valued and desired and I know that only you can do that. I can’t wait to see what you do next because I know that I couldn’t leave you or stop supporting you if I tried. On behalf of your friends, Stay, members, and most importantly family, I pray that this birthday is filled with all of those blessings that you deserve and that it’s everything that you desire. I pray that you and your loved ones remain in good health and good faith, because the world is relying on it in order to fully heal and love each other. Happy early birthday Bang Chan, and from the bottom of my heart, we absolutely adore you. You make Stray Kids all around the world stay.

United States
The U.S. House of Representatives passed a bipartisan bill (413 to 2) on March 27, 2023, to oppose the state-sanctioned forced organ harvesting in China. Also known as H.R.1154 – The Stop Forced Organ Harvesting Act of 2023, this was the first bill passed with a bipartisan majority to hold the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) accountable for these crimes.


The United States Capitol


H.R.1154 – The Stop Forced Organ Harvesting Act of 2023 was passed on March 27.

The bill reads: “The President must report to Congress a list of persons that facilitate (1) forced organ harvesting, or (2) trafficking in persons for organ harvesting. For each person on the list, the President must impose property- and visa-blocking sanctions.”

In addition, “the State Department may deny or revoke the passport of an individual who has been convicted of a federal crime of knowingly transferring any human organ for valuable consideration for use in human transplantation, if the individual (1) is subject to imprisonment or supervised release resulting from that conviction, and (2) used a passport or crossed an international border when committing that crime.”

Furthermore, the Act imposes against such crimes: 1) civil penalties including a fine of up to $250,000, and 2) criminal penalties including a fine of up to $1 million and imprisonment for not more than 20 years for such crimes.

This legislation was authored by House Representative Chris Smith (Republican), co-chair of the Congressional-Executive Commission on China, who said, “These crimes against humanity are unimaginable.

“Ethnic groups targeted for mass harvesting include Uyghurs—who suffer from Xi Jinping’s ongoing genocide—and the Falun Gong, whose peaceful meditation and exercise practices—and exceptional good health—make their organs highly desirable.”

Tom Cotton, Republican Senator, and Chris Coons, Democratic Senator, initiated a Senate version of the legislation along with more than ten other senators.

text:
Finally! I was so excitedly waiting for this video performance, the coreography is completely on another level.
HYUNJIN's dance is spectacular, it is pure art. As he marks the steps, it seems that time freezes a couple of milli seconds between one step and another, and the power and strength with which he executes each movement is perfect. It gives such a sexy energy to a choreography that is not made to be sensual. His talent is simply overwhelming.
And what can we say about FELIX's voice, is there anyone who doesn't melt like ice under the summer sun with his deep voice? Its sound buries itself directly into the soul, the words it sings are only the roses that it sticks into your chest to take root in you.
Then we have the imposing charisma of BANG CHANG that does not allow him to go unnoticed, his presence on stage is devastating for any mortal and when he takes the central position something changes in the feeling that the entire group transmits.
On this occasion I.N surprised me, first of all that hair color looks very good on him, but apart from that, I get the feeling that his participation stood out more on this occasion, and I love it because he has a beautiful, perfect voice color for the most melodic parts of the song.

A Rede SMG (Pare o Genocídio Médico: Sociedade para o Estudo do Transplante de Órgãos na China) realizou um seminário em Tóquio em 2 de abril de 2023. O seminário expôs as atrocidades do Partido Comunista Chinês (PCC) e convocou o comunidade internacional para ajudar a parar a perseguição aos praticantes do Falun Dafa.

O renomado advogado canadense de direitos humanos David Matas discursou no seminário e disse: “A extração forçada de órgãos de praticantes do Falun Dafa vivosé um ato criminoso. Este é um flagrante ato de genocídio”.

Participaram do evento diretores de associações de jornalistas médicos, repórteres de jornais, presidentes de empresas e consultores seniores de pequenas e médias empresas.



O advogado canadense de direitos humanos David Matas profere uma palestra no evento realizado em Tóquio em 2 de abril de 2023.

O Sr. Matas disse: “A resistência pacífica dos praticantes do Falun Dafa à perseguição criou um impacto. Eles me deram muito incentivo. O sistema massivo do PCC para extração forçada de órgãos vivos está em andamento há 22 anos e os números são inacreditáveis”. Ele pediu ao PCC que pare com essa atrocidade.

O Sr. Aoki, especialista em apoiar pequenas e médias empresas no exterior, disse: “A verdadeira China só existirá quando o PCC se desintegrar. Os praticantes do Falun Dafa têm persistido por causa de sua fé e acreditam firmemente nos princípios Verdade-Compaixão-Tolerância. Eles definitivamente resistirão e testemunharão o dia em que o PCC entrará em colapso”.

O Sr. Hibino Morio tem acompanhado a questão da “morte cerebral e transplante de órgãos”. Ele disse: “Os praticantes do Falun Dafa não representam uma ameaça. É sua liberdade realizar atividades e é aceitável em países civilizados. É absolutamente inaceitável deter e considerar culpados esses inocentes. Também é inaceitável extrair seus órgãos”.

O Sr. e a Sra. Hashimoto disseram: “Os praticantes do Falun Dafa não cometeram nenhum crime. É absolutamente terrível saber que eles podem desaparecer da face da terra em um dia. Não entendemos por que esse grupo de pessoas compassivas está sendo perseguido. Apoiamos os praticantes do Falun Dafa e não podemos permitir que a extração forçada de órgãos de pessoas vivas aconteça na China. Esperamos que os praticantes no exterior não desistam. Esperamos que persistam até o fim e tenham um grande impacto no mundo”.

ハンのカッコ良すぎるリズミカルな韓英ラップ、

アイエンのアギパンからのお色気憑依パンへの成長と

相変わらず特徴的で個性的なダンス、
